description: This file contains utility functions for handling form output, entity conversions, and related product retrieval in a CRM system. It includes functions to generate HTML for various field types, convert sales entities like quotes and orders, and fetch associated product details.

classes.name: CurrencyField
classes.description: A class for handling currency conversions and display values, used in formatting monetary fields.

classes.name: DateTimeField
classes.description: A class providing static methods for date/time formatting and zone conversions.

methods.name: getOutputHtml
methods.description: Generates the HTML representation of a form field based on its type and current value, for rendering in edit views.

methods.name: getConvertSoToInvoice
methods.description: Populates an Invoice object with data from a Sales Order, used in conversion processes.

methods.name: getConvertQuoteToInvoice
methods.description: Fills an Invoice object with data from a Quote, facilitating conversion from quote to invoice.

methods.name: getConvertQuoteToSoObject
methods.description: Converts a Quote object into a Sales Order object, copying relevant fields.

methods.name: getAssociatedProducts
methods.description: Retrieves the list of products associated with a given entity (like Quote, Order, etc.), including details like quantity and price.
